sections.text:
The maintenance works require putting the turbo-generator out of operation for 
 a long period about 3 weeks. During such repair, the turbine bodies are not 
 usually opened. Only the inspection of selected wholes or inspection is 
 performed, e.g.:

items: Inspect the bearings
Inspect the control of the gland steam with instrument maintenance department.

Inspect the control circuit of the lubrication oil temperature by instrument 
 maintenance department.
Check the function of the starting-up equipment and the removal of defects.

Check the function of lifting pump or the adjustment of pressure the function 
 of oil pumps driven by electric motors and of the oil steam fan or their 
 repairs.
Clean and test oil cooler of turbine.
Clean all magnetic filters of bearings of turbine.
Clean fine screen of oil tank.
Inspect and adjust the opening stroke of control valve of turbine.
Moreover all the defects found out during the operation will be removed.
Purify the oil of turbine by oil separator
Check revolution per minute for turning gear.

Check all protection of turbine such as over speed, decrease of vacuum and 
 temperature of bearing.

Shutdown the unit.
Generator should be isolated.
Isolate the circuit breaker of Generator.
Disconnect the electric terminals of Generator.
The oil of Turbine must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and 
 suction valves.
Be sure Turbine must be completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller

Vibrometer, Straight edge

Work to be Carried out
The maintenance works require putting the turbo-generator out of operation for 
 a long period about 3 weeks. During such repair, the turbine bodies are not 
 usually opened. Only the inspection of selected wholes or inspection is 
 performed, e.g.:
Inspect the bearings
Inspect the control of the gland steam with instrument maintenance department.
Inspect the control circuit of the lubrication oil temperature by instrument 
 maintenance department.
Check the function of the starting-up equipment and the removal of defects.
Check the function of lifting pump or the adjustment of pressure the function 
 of oil pumps driven by electric motors and of the oil steam fan or their 
 repairs.
Clean and test oil cooler of turbine.
Clean all magnetic filters of bearings of turbine.
Clean fine screen of oil tank.
Inspect and adjust the opening stroke of control valve of turbine.
Moreover all the defects found out during the operation will be removed.
Purify the oil of turbine by oil separator
Check revolution per minute for turning gear.
Check all protection of turbine such as over speed, decrease of vacuum and 
 temperature of bearing.
